testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, tab, dialog, modal trigger, card, and key text element MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Never use generic flat gradients across the full screen. Use warm obsidian (#0D1117) or cream linen (#FAF8F5) with rich textures and 1px crisp borders.
Do NOT use Inter for main titles. Use Google Font Playfair Display for headers and IBM Plex Sans for body.
Make the kinetic heading transitions distinctly smooth, interactive, and visually striking. Include manual dot/tab switches as well as an automatic 5-second interval.

The Mock Login flow MUST feel real: clicking login shows a polished modal with quick-fill test credentials ('VIP Buyer' or 'Luxury Seller') and immediately opens a sleek client portal overview with their saved Cincinnati homes, portfolio value, and direct contact options.

ChatGPT AI integration must be fully operational on both frontend and backend. Ensure the backend `/api/chat` route supports selecting OpenAI models (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-3.5-turbo), responds intelligently to Cincinnati queries, and includes a well-crafted local Cincinnati real estate prompt context with mock fallback if the API key is not yet set in environment variables.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes exactly as specified.
Keep CTA buttons crisp, high contrast, and accessible with explicit hover states.
